integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained for the new upper bound. The included computation is only a finite consistency check and is not used to infer the all-orders theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to regular odd polygons. It does not determine the invariant for even regular polygons or arbitrary convex polygons, and it uses the published four-intersection lower bound for every boundary point of a regular odd polygon.
title: Exact Erdős circle-intersection invariant of regular odd polygons
